text: This report recommends that the name "Nanak Lane" be approved to identify an existing public lane south of Richmond Street West, extending easterly from Tecumseth Street. Community Councils have delegated authority to decide street naming matters which comply with the City of Toronto Street Naming Policy.
The Toronto and East York Community Council: 1. Approved the name "Nanak Lane" for an existing public lane south of Richmond Street West, extending easterly from Tecumseth Street.
